label: The subsistent-esse premise pair is equivalent to its composite, checked
description: Forward: from whole-power possession and purity-as-perfection-of-being, what is its own being has each pure perfection. Backward: take 'perfection of being' to be 'pure perfection'; the purity premise is then trivial and whole-power possession is the composite. Premise-free: the equivalence of the pair, existentially closed over the primitive, with the composite; a general fact about middle-term decompositions, not a certificate of warrant.
